item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-6a00b7dacac9207e","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"Egypt enacted Law No. 91 of 2023, approving the state general budget for fiscal year 2023/2024; the Official Gazette entry is dated 30 June 2023 and identifies the President as author.","question_ids":["5B.1","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"Directly within 2023; the document identifies enactment of the budget law but provides no execution or outcome data.","ruler_attribution":"The gazette record identifies the President as author, but does not establish Abdel Fattah el-Sisi's personal role beyond formal promulgation.","limitations":["No budget amounts, allocations, implementation records, or results are supplied."]},{"source_id":"SRC-22871d1b3e9d98d0","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"On 30 January 2023, an OHCHR special-procedures communication recorded information alleging the mass arrest of 28 men suspected of homosexuality, with alleged denial of protection against torture and other ill-treatment, privacy, liberty and security, and freedom from discrimination based on sexual orientation or gender identity.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Communication dated 30 January 2023; it reports allegations rather than an adjudicated finding.","ruler_attribution":"The source concerns Egypt during el-Sisi's presidency but does not attribute the alleged conduct directly to him.","limitations":["Allegations are recorded as information received; no response or final determination is included."]},{"source_id":"SRC-92426a506cd2adbb","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"An OHCHR summary states that the application of Egypt's Anti-Terrorism, Protest, Association, and NGO laws from 2017 onward raised serious concerns about arbitrary detention, alleged torture, lack of judicial oversight and procedural safeguards, restrictions on expression and peaceful assembly, and socio-economic-rights violations in Sinai involving education, housing, development, food, and water.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.4","3B.5","3B.8","3B.10","4B.3","4B.9","6B.2"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The stated period is 2017 to present and ongoing, encompassing 2023; the document is not limited to events occurring in 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The concerns describe state-law application during el-Sisi's tenure but do not establish his personal direction of each practice.","limitations":["The summary gives no quantified victim total and no final judicial findings or corrective measures."]},{"source_id":"SRC-f445b9cd8d9f8fd8","start_unit":1,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"The UN Human Rights Committee adopted concluding observations on Egypt's fifth periodic report at its 137th session, held from 27 February to 24 March 2023; the observations were dated 14 April 2023 and concern Egypt's compliance with the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights.","question_ids":["3B.4","4B.4","7B.6","7B.7"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"Directly dated to 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The record concerns Egypt's state reporting and the Committee's review during el-Sisi's presidency, without supplying the substantive observations or attributing conduct personally to him.","limitations":["Only bibliographic and procedural metadata are supplied; the document's substantive findings and recommendations are not included."]},{"source_id":"SRC-132c8825340ab5d6","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"OHCHR recorded information that at least 88 people were arrested during and after peaceful October 2023 demonstrations expressing solidarity with Palestinians; several were allegedly forcibly disappeared, 67 were reportedly held pre-trial in overcrowded and inadequate conditions, and access to legal counsel was denied. The arrests reportedly used counter-terrorism and national-security accusations and Law No. 107/2013 on peaceful protests.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.5","3B.8","3B.9","4B.3","4B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly concerns October 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The source describes Egyptian authorities' alleged conduct during el-Sisi's presidency but does not establish his personal authorization or knowledge.","limitations":["The account is information received by OHCHR and is not presented as a final adjudication."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4451c8d4bc73312d","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"On 26 September 2023, the Egyptian Parliament's General Secretariat made nomination-endorsement forms available to members for the 2024 presidential election, implementing Article 142 of the Constitution and Article 108 of the parliamentary rules. Each candidate required endorsements from 20 members; members had to sign personally and could endorse only one candidate.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.8","8B.2"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"Directly dated to 26 September 2023 and concerns preparations for the 2024 election.","ruler_attribution":"This is an official parliamentary administrative action; it does not establish personal direction by el-Sisi or whether the process was genuinely competitive in practice.","limitations":["No information is supplied on candidates' access, voter choice, campaign conditions, or election results."]},{"source_id":"SRC-79a2b273a3e8f2d4","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"The Egyptian Parliament's constitutional webpage identifies Egypt as a sovereign, unified, republican democratic state based on citizenship and the rule of law, and presents the Constitution's rights-and-governance structure including state, social foundations, rights and freedoms, rule of law, government, and parliamentary chapters.","question_ids":["4B.4","4B.7","4B.8"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"The webpage is undated and records constitutional text in force during the 2023 period, but does not document a 2023 decision or implementation event.","ruler_attribution":"The constitutional text defines the formal state framework but does not establish el-Sisi's conduct or compliance.","limitations":["No evidence is supplied about practical enforcement, institutional independence, or rights outcomes."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-c6a460fffe75d859","SRC-5e5401f65671723c","SRC-9f13dd5b99ae3635","SRC-3465f5b736e5c098","SRC-2784d65bbec519bc"],"batch_limitations":["Several supplied records are catalog metadata without substantive findings, statistics, or implementation results.","The supplied sources provide limited direct evidence of Abdel Fattah el-Sisi's personal decisions; many facts concern Egyptian institutions or alleged state conduct during his presidency.","No supplied document contains substantive evidence relevant to most nuclear-risk, international-peace, integrity, or effectiveness lenses."]}
